scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @zenfg/snapshot && npm run build --workspace @zenfg/webgpu && npm run build --workspace @zenfg/inspector
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace @zenfg/site-app && npm run build --workspace @zenfg/inspector-app && npm run build --workspace @zenfg/playground-app
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.dev:all: npm run build:packages && concurrently --kill-others --names site,inspector,playground --prefix-colors blue,magenta,cyan "npm run dev --workspace @zenfg/site-app -- --port 5173 --strictPort" "npm run dev --workspace @zenfg/inspector-app -- --port 5174 --strictPort --base /inspector/" "npm run dev --workspace @zenfg/playground-app -- --port 5175 --strictPort --base /playground/"
scripts.dev:inspector: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @zenfg/inspector-app -- --port 5174 --strictPort
scripts.dev:playground: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @zenfg/playground-app -- --port 5175 --strictPort
scripts.dev:site: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @zenfg/site-app -- --port 5173 --strictPort
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck:examples && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
